verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages link a public 'Track Application Status' / 'Track Status' entry for patents, trademarks and GI. It resolves to a public status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in, and no account is named on the entry. Case-level visibility comes from public Cause Lists, Dynamic Hearing Cause Lists and Controller's Decisions. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that a lookup returns usable status detail, and documentation of what status fields and history the search shows (evidence is mostly navigation labels).
